comment: Staged screenshot scenes for Solmara: Streets of the Sun. Each entry loads game/index.html with ?shot=<scene> at 1280x720; the scene is seeded and stepped deterministically by game/src/shots.js, so the same scene always renders the same frame.

shots.shows: Title screen over the live city: traffic and pedestrians moving behind the menu
Police chase at three wanted stars: cruisers behind the player's sports car, minimap and mission objective on the HUD
On-foot mission moment: Mara facing the informant Sal in Old Town, pedestrians and traffic around, a wanted star up
Wide city drive: Mara driving through the plaza district on a courier job, traffic, minimap and mission marker visible
